page.title: EBSD Analysis
page.subtitle: MTEX-equivalent post-processing: grain analysis, deformation, texture, recrystallization
page.emptyHint: Run indexing first and use the “→ Analysis” button, or load a CrystalMap (.h5 / .ang / .ctf) from the Data tab below.
page.runCompleteTooltip: Run all analysis steps: Grain Reconstruction → Deformation → Texture → RX Classification

tabs.dataTip: Load CrystalMap, apply tilt/rotation corrections, clean low-BC pixels
tabs.grainsTip: Reconstruct grains, compute ECD/MaxDim/AR grain size statistics
tabs.deformationTip: KAM, grain boundary classification (HAGB/SAGB), BC histogram + GMM
tabs.textureTip: ODF, 14 texture components (Cube, Goss, Brass, S, ...), pole figures
tabs.batchTip: Process folder of datasets, export Documentation.xlsx (14 sheets)

status.ready: Ready — Load a CrystalMap file to begin
status.batchHandoffFailed: Batch handoff failed: {{msg}}. Make sure .ang export was enabled.
status.completeFinished: Complete analysis finished — all steps done

map.selectLayerHint: Select a layer and press Refresh
map.layerTooltip: Choose the analysis map layer to render.
map.colormapTooltip: Choose the matplotlib colormap for the rendered map.
map.refreshTooltip: Render the selected layer and colormap.

layers.ipfTip: Crystal orientation colored by sample normal (Z)
layers.ipf_xTip: Crystal orientation colored by rolling direction (X)
layers.ipf_yTip: Crystal orientation colored by transverse direction (Y)
layers.kamTip: Kernel Average Misorientation — local strain indicator
layers.ecdTip: Equivalent Circle Diameter — grain area mapped to circle
layers.texture_componentTip: Color-coded texture components (Cube, Goss, Brass, etc.)
layers.grain_boundariesTip: HAGB (>15°) and SAGB (2-15°) grain boundary network

data.loadTooltip: Load the CrystalMap at the entered path for analysis.
data.qualityDesc: Mark pixels below the threshold as unindexed so they drop out of every downstream statistic. Reload to reset.
data.qualityFilterResult: Filtered {{total}} px ({{pct}}%) — {{byBc}} by BC, {{byBands}} by Bands. {{after}} of {{before}} pixels remain indexed. Reload the file to reset.
data.minBandContrastTooltip: Pixels with band contrast below this value are marked unindexed.
data.minBandsTooltip: Pixels with fewer detected bands than this are marked unindexed.
data.applyQualityFilterTooltip: Mark low-quality pixels as unindexed across all downstream statistics.
data.preprocNotImplemented: Preprocessing is not yet implemented on the backend. Parameters noted but not applied.
data.aztecDesc: Compare Aztec's per-pixel Phase + Euler (from the source h5oina) against the currently loaded result. Reveals phase-call disagreements and orientation drift between indexers.
data.aztecImageAlt: Aztec vs GPU: Phase and orientation comparison
data.compareWithAztecTooltip: Confront Aztec's per-pixel phase and orientation with the loaded result.
data.misorientationNote: Note: high mean misorientation ({{mean}}°) often indicates a sample-frame convention mismatch (Aztec/HKL vs TSL), not a real orientation error.
data.loadEdsElementsTooltip: Read the EDS element list from the loaded dataset.
data.suggestFromEdsTooltip: Suggest candidate crystal phases from the EDS At.% composition.

grain.gbThresholdTooltip: Minimum misorientation (degrees) that defines a grain boundary.
grain.minGrainSizeTooltip: Grains smaller than this pixel count are merged into neighbours.
grain.minInterceptTooltip: Minimum mean intercept length (µm) for a valid grain.
grain.reconstructGrainsTooltip: Reconstruct grains from the orientation map using the thresholds above.
grain.analyzeSizeTooltip: Compute ECD, maximum dimension and aspect-ratio grain-size statistics.

deformation.kamOrderTooltip: Kernel ring order (1-3) for the KAM neighbourhood.
deformation.hagbThresholdTooltip: Misorientation (degrees) above which a boundary counts as high-angle (HAGB).
deformation.analyzeTooltip: Compute KAM, grain-boundary classification and sphericity.
deformation.gmmDesc: Fits three Gaussians: Deformed / Recovered / Recrystallized
deformation.fitGmmTooltip: Fit a 3-Gaussian mixture model to the BC histogram (Deformed/Recovered/RX).

texture.presetFcc: FCC Rolling — Al, Cu, Ni (14 components)
texture.presetTooltip: Choose the texture-component preset (FCC or BCC rolling families).
texture.toleranceTooltip: Maximum misorientation (degrees) for a grain to count toward a texture component.
texture.loadComponentsTooltip: List the texture components of the selected preset without running the ODF.
texture.analyzeTooltip: Compute the ODF, texture-component fractions, surface planes, index and entropy.

rx.gosThresholdTooltip: Grains with grain-orientation-spread below this (degrees) count as recrystallized.
rx.gbcFractionTooltip: Minimum grain-average band-contrast fraction for a grain to count as recrystallized.
rx.gkamThresholdTooltip: Maximum grain-average KAM (degrees) for a recrystallized grain.
rx.minGrainRadiusTooltip: Grains smaller than this radius (µm) are excluded from RX classification.
rx.classifyTooltip: Classify grains as Recrystallized / Recovered / Deformed using GOS/gBC/gKAM criteria.

batch.browseFolderTooltip: Browse for the folder of datasets to process.
batch.browseOutputTooltip: Choose where to save the Documentation.xlsx output.
batch.processFolderTooltip: Process every dataset in the folder and write a combined Documentation.xlsx.
batch.exportDesc: Export current dataset analysis to Excel (14 sheets — Documentation.xlsx format).
batch.browseExportTooltip: Choose where to save the exported .xlsx file.
batch.downloadExcelTooltip: Export the current dataset's analysis to a 14-sheet Documentation.xlsx.

hoverTips.sessionSelect: Load the CrystalMap from a recent indexing session for analysis.
hoverTips.xmapPath: Path to the CrystalMap file (.h5 / .h5oina / .ang / .ctf) to load.
